correctness.rationale: Reconstructed ordinary Mycielski graph originals, clones, apex, and natural layerwise D_n action. For an invariant independent original union, some clone orbit remains optional and cancels all apex-free terms in the signed sum; apex-present terms negate the original graph sum. Therefore reduced equivariant Lefschetz numbers satisfy Ltilde(Ind(mu(G)),h)=-Ltilde(Ind(G),h) for all h, without assuming equivariant suspension. Combine the ordinary suspension theorem and cycle sphere/wedge types to localize homology degree q and rank, then use orbit quotient C_d and P_t polynomials and rational Reynolds averaging to prove every trace and mod-12 invariant criterion. Independently enumerated full signed oriented-face Lefschetz traces on the actual Mycielski graphs for all D_n elements n=4..7. The finite test verifies signs and boundary cases only; the orbit cancellation and ordinary homotopy input prove all n.

value.rationale: The all-order dihedral trace classification and mod-twelve quotient homology provide structural information not fixed by the known ordinary Mycielski suspension or sphere-wedge ranks. In particular the even-cycle reflection-axis split and rank-two n divisible by three are natural previously uncovered regimes; the proper overlap with an odd-cycle integral theorem does not trivialize the general classification.

final_claim: For n>=4 the ordinary one-step Mycielskian of C_n has rational reduced homology in degree q(n) only, with dimension 2 if 3|n else 1; complete rotation/reflection characters follow signed Mycielski-Lefschetz cancellation and cycle orbit-polynomial recurrences; full dihedral quotient is rationally nontrivial exactly when n mod 12 is 1 or 11.
limitations: Canonical natural D_n subgroup only; rational quotient, not integral torsion or all graph automorphisms.
Proper subfamily odd n>=5, 3∤n already covered by same-day stronger integral generalized theorem.
residual_risks: Same-day generalized odd-cycle publication overlaps exactly on an infinite proper subfamily; authorship/temporal priority for that subset unresolved.
Unindexed all-n equivariant suspension or character derivation may cover remaining even and divisible-by-three cases.
